# Libraries

Copies of the libraries the Shiny app loaded, at the same versions, so the website never downloads or updates anything on its own.

| Folder | Library | Version | License | Taken from |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| bootstrap | Bootstrap with the Cosmo theme | 5.3.8 | MIT | bootswatch (dist/cosmo), bslib (bootstrap.bundle.min.js) |
| jquery | jQuery | 3.6.0 | MIT | jquerylib |
| datatables | DataTables with Bootstrap 5 styling | 1.13.6 | MIT | DT |
| leaflet | Leaflet | 1.3.1 | BSD-2-Clause | leaflet (R package) |
| markercluster | Leaflet.markercluster | | MIT | leaflet (R package) |
| fontawesome | Font Awesome Free (solid and regular) | 6.5.2 | Icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT | fontawesome (R package) |
